chapter_seo_title: The Emperor of Daliang: A Brutal Beheading and a Belly Full of Secrets
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang escorts a screaming, golden-masked man claiming to be the Emperor of Daliang to his beheading, only to find a grotesque secret hidden inside the corpse.
og_title: The Emperor of Daliang: A Brutal Beheading and a Belly Full of Secrets
og_description: A quick execution at the Meridian Gate, a golden mask, and a belly packed full of elixir pills—Li Huowang learns that in the capital, even the condemned are secrets waiting to be cut open.
twitter_title: Beheaded in two hours. A belly full of pills.
twitter_description: Li Huowang's first job in the capital is a nightmare in broad daylight: a screaming 'emperor,' a golden mask, and a crowd collecting blood.

lore_anchors.definition: A secret, sacrificial art from the Ao-Jing Sect that nearly always kills its user. Surviving it marks a person as something beyond ordinary mortal.
The main southern gate of the imperial palace, historically used for formal announcements and, in this world, for swift public executions.
An ancient Bronze Age civilization in China known for producing bizarre, abstract bronze masks with exaggerated features, often associated with shamanic ritual.
A grim folk practice rooted in the belief that the blood of a powerful or unjustly executed person has medicinal properties.
